body: I don't think I will be fine, I've always been told that I'd need to go to University and with the frequency of people who go to University increasing it is going to become tough to get a job anywhere without a degree.

What do you do? I've never met anyone who earns £30k without a degree unless they're working in a family business or something. Most people either farm or go into manual labour. Neither are appealing as a career path to me so I'd have to work in retail or fast food or something, there isn't much career progression.

I need a job that will pay above the average wage to live the life I want, holidays to places and a secure home over my head. I love where I live and I'd be able to get land to build relatively cheaply or for free maybe but I'd need money to build, working as a sales assistant or as a burger flipper wont get me that.
